about_the_game:
🔥 Welcome to Battle Babes: Unity, Duality & Order! 🔥

This DLC expands your Battle Babes experience by adding three potent new Hero Power Decks: Unity, Duality & Order! Master these new strategies alongside the ever-growing roster of heroines.

Like all major Battle Babes DLCs, purchasing Unity, Duality & Order grants you access to the base game content AND all previously released DLC content, giving you the complete Battle Babes collection up to this point.

Content Included with this Purchase:

  • Base Game (Free to Play Content): Fire, Water, Nature Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 1: Battle Babes: Blood, Sun & Moon: Adds Blood, Sun, Moon Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 2: Lightning: Adds the Lightning Hero Power Deck.

  • DLC 3: Love & Death: Adds Love, Death Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 4: Lust, Space & Shadow: Adds Lust, Space, Shadow Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 5: Wind, Frost & Astra: Adds Wind, Frost, Astra Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 6: Earth, Air & Ocean: Adds Earth, Air, Ocean Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 7: Chaos, Sin & Domination: Adds Chaos, Sin, Domination Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 8: Luck, Speed & Greed: Adds Luck, Speed, Greed Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 9: Cyber, Wrath & Peace: Adds Cyber, Wrath, Peace Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 10: Magic, Alchemy & Time: Adds Magic, Alchemy, Time Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 11: Crystal, Dream & Gem: Adds Crystal, Dream, Gem Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 12: Celestial, Aurora & Void: Adds Celestial, Aurora, Void Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 13: Storm, Star & Salt: Adds Storm, Star, Salt Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 14: Plasma, Ion & Nebula: Adds Plasma, Ion, Nebula Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 15: Rainbow, Venom & Flux: Adds Rainbow, Venom, Flux Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 16: Myth, Mirror & Madness: Adds Myth, Mirror, Madness Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 17: Alien, Gaia & Meteor: Adds Alien, Gaia, Meteor Hero Power Decks.

  • DLC 18: Unity, Duality & Order (This DLC): Adds Unity, Duality & Order Hero Power Decks.

(Purchasing this DLC unlocks ALL content listed above).

👁️ Key Features You Unlock with 'Unity, Duality & Order': 👁️

  • Play & Battle All 54 Hero Power Decks: Master Fire, Water, Nature, Blood, Sun, Moon, Lightning, Love, Death, Lust, Space, Shadow, Wind, Frost, Astra, Earth, Air, Ocean, Chaos, Sin, Domination, Luck, Speed, Greed, Cyber, Wrath, Peace, Magic, Alchemy, Time, Crystal, Dream, Gem, Celestial, Aurora, Void, Storm, Star, Salt, Plasma, Ion, Nebula, Rainbow, Venom, Flux, Myth, Mirror, Madness, Alien, Gaia, Meteor, Unity, Duality & Order!

  • Over 2,000 Distinctive Cards: Collect and wield a vast arsenal brimming with unique magic, powers, and abilities.

  • Mini-Games & Gems (from Battle Babes 2): Enjoy Snooker, Pool, Poker, Blackjack, Chess, Checkers, Mafia, BBL (Battle Babes League), Asteroids, Snake, Aim Trainer, Space Invaders, Brick Break, and Match-3—all included! Win coins and gems in every mini-game to super-charge your Babes, unlock card packs, and earn Star Power.

  • Browse Mode: Indulge hands-free in the beautiful art of Battle Babes!

  • Defeat Challenging AI Boss Decks: Conquer the Dragon Clan & Succubus Queen. Earn coins, buy card packs, and collect blessed cards.

  • 800+ Powerful Proverb Voicelines: Hear motivating proverbs trigger mid-battle.

  • Win of the Day Bonus: Claim 1,000 coins & 100 gems daily for your first Solo Battle win.

  • Dynamic Turn-Based Combat: Engage in electrifying battles blending strategy and chance.

  • Deck Customization: Mix babes, spells, secrets, and artifacts.

  • Incremental Idle Progression: Level up Babes and boost Star Power with coins and gems.

  • Exquisite Artwork & Frequent Updates: Stunning illustrations and regular content drops.

  • Interactive Tutorials & Beginner-Friendly: Learn the basics easily.

  • Play Solo: Sharpen skills against advanced AI.

🌌 Join the Battle Babes Universe 🌌

Battle Babes is where sass meets class, elegance meets energy, artistry meets ambition. Easy to learn yet challenging to master—like conquering the art of walking in stilettos. Regular updates ensure you’ll never get bored. Sharpen your skills, customize your decks, and engage in fierce battles against worthy adversaries.

Join the Battle Babes saga today and carve your path to glory! Collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with the sassiest, most powerful Babes in the realm.

What are you waiting for? Don’t make these Babes wait! 💋

content_descriptors.notes:
Battle Babes features some seriously revealing outfits and veiled nudity. It's packed with suggestive themes, steamy scenarios, domination, and content that may not be appropriate for all audiences.

Some artwork includes themes of light, fantasy-based bondage, such as characters being loosely bound by elements like spiky vines.

Certain images depict characters with minor injuries (cuts, scrapes, scars) and in states of emotional distress (crying, sadness).
